sections.heading: In-Game Description
sections.text:
A cup filled with divine waters, a drink popular with nobles of the palace.
When a wedding procession arrives at the Fountainhead palace, this is the drink they are greeted with.
"The nectar of the palace nobles.
Go ahead, drink to your heart's content."

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text:
Give to the Head Priest of Mibu Village to receive Dragonspring Sake: upon reloading the area, the Priest will have turned into a Palace Noble that drops Treasure Carp Scale [x5] upon death.
The room this item is found in can only be access by swimming down the pool in front of the Okami Spear-Bearer and Palace Noble shortly before the Flower Viewing Stage Sculptor's Idol.
